rows.title: Track-only routes never trade
rows.defect: the row's trade flag is trusted over its route
rows.test: a Plaid row that says trade is still track-only

rows.title: Off rows can do nothing
rows.defect: the off check reads a field the matrix never sets
rows.test: every prediction market and crypto row is Off

rows.title: Off today even on a live route
rows.defect: today() skips the off check and follows the parent
rows.test: Robinhood event contracts are Off though Plaid is live

rows.title: Unverified coverage is a try
rows.defect: unverified coverage is promised as connect
rows.test: SoFi through Plaid is a try, not connect

rows.title: A shared account follows its parent
rows.defect: a shared row is judged on its own
rows.test: Ellevest is a try because Betterment is

rows.title: A fallback needs a live row
rows.defect: any row on the fallback route counts, live or not
rows.test: no live Plaid row means not built

rows.title: A fallback is read-only
rows.defect: a fallback that could trade passes
rows.test: a SnapTrade fallback fails validation

rows.title: Verified live needs a live adapter
rows.defect: a built adapter counts as live
rows.test: verified_live with a built adapter fails

rows.title: No password sign-in on any route
rows.defect: a stored password is accepted as a manual sign-in
rows.test: auth password on a manual route fails

rows.title: The route is the research's best
rows.defect: the route check runs only on shared rows
rows.test: a Plaid row whose research names SnapTrade is a contradiction

rows.title: An off platform is itself
rows.defect: an off shared row connects through its parent
rows.test: ForecastEx is Off, not Interactive Brokers

rows.title: Whole words only
rows.defect: a name matches inside another word
rows.test: 'really' is not Ally

rows.title: Full names with punctuation
rows.defect: names keep their punctuation while the words lose it (the bug this packet found)
rows.test: 'ForecastEx (Interactive Brokers)' is ForecastEx, Off

rows.title: A missing step is NOT_WIRED
rows.defect: only a missing adapter is NOT_WIRED; a missing step throws and reads as a failure
rows.test: an adapter without connect answers NOT_WIRED

rows.title: Off platforms never reach an adapter
rows.defect: the adapter is built for an off row
rows.test: Kalshi, Coinbase and Robinhood Crypto never call it

rows.title: Track-only never orders
rows.defect: the row's trade flag decides, not the route
rows.test: a Plaid row that claims trading still refuses

rows.title: A yes on the order's own card
rows.defect: any truthy approval passes
rows.test: approved 'yes' or no card id is not an approval

rows.title: $5.00 in cents
rows.defect: the estimate is compared in dollars against a cap in cents
rows.test: 501 cents is over the cap

rows.title: A bad host cap falls back to $5
rows.defect: any positive value is taken as the cap
rows.test: Infinity or '100000' is not a cap

rows.title: The card only where it connects
rows.defect: every connect-now platform gets the card
rows.test: Fidelity through Plaid gets no card
